```{r}
library(terra)
library(bDSSDMTools)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
# Load a vector defining global landmass
landmass <- vect("C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Landmass/landmass.shp")

#plot
plot(landmass, col="#D4D4D4", border = "#D4D4D4", axes = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Let's look at the file first!
readLines("C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Seagrass/species_presence_absence_records.csv", n=3)
records <- read.csv("C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Seagrass/species_presence_absence_records.csv", sep = ";")

# Tranform data frame into a spatial object
records <- vect(records, geom = c("Lon", "Lat"))

# Plot Record
plot(landmass, main = "Species distribution records", col = "#D4D4D4", border = "#D4D4D4", axes = TRUE)
plot(records, y="PA", col = c("#c29431", "#043259"), pch = 16, cex = 0.5, add = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Get important environmental layers
files <- c("C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Present Benthic DissolvedMolecularOxygen Mean.tif", # Oxygen
"C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Present Benthic OceanTemperature LtMax.tif", # Temperature Max
"C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Present Benthic OceanTemperature LtMin.tif", # Temperature Min
"C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Present Benthic pH Mean.tif", # pH
"C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Present Benthic TotalPrimaryProductionPhyto Mean.tif", # Productivity
"C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Present Benthic Salinity Mean.tif"
)

environmentalLayers <- rast(files)
plot(environmentalLayers)
```

```{r}
# develop a study region
myStudyRegion <- studyRegion(rasterLayers=environmentalLayers,
presences=records, # presence records
distanceThreshold=200000, # distance from records in meters
bathymetryLayer = "C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Bathymetry.tif", # bathymetry layer
depthPref=c(0,-500), # known vertical distribution
intertidalLayer = "C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/CoastLine.tif" ) # consider intertidal region

plot(myStudyRegion, main="Study region", col="#979797", axes=TRUE)
```
```{r}
environmentalLayers <- crop(environmentalLayers, myStudyRegion)
environmentalLayers <- mask(environmentalLayers, myStudyRegion)
plot(environmentalLayers, axes = TRUE)
```
```{r}
modelData <- generateModelData(records, envConditions = environmentalLayers)
model <- trainModel(modelData, algorithm = "brt")
prediction <- predictModel(model = model, newData = environmentalLayers)
plot(prediction$rasterLayer, main = "Predicted species distribution", col = rev(topo.colors(100)))
```

```{r}
presences <- read.csv("C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Corals/occurrenceRecords.csv")

presences <- vect(presences, geom = c("Lon", "Lat"))

plot(landmass, main = "Coral Species Records", col = "#D4D4D4", border = "#D4D4D4", axes = TRUE)
plot(presences, y="speciesName", col = c("#034B03"), pch = 16, cex = 0.5, add = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Plot in study region
ct_extent <- ext(-100, -55, 0, 32)
presences_ct <- crop(presences, ct_extent)

plot(landmass, main = "Coral Species Records", col = "#D4D4D4", border = "#D4D4D4", axes = TRUE)
plot(presences_ct, col = "#034B03", pch = 16, cex = 0.4, add = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Develop study region area
myStudyRegion2 <- studyRegion(rasterLayers = environmentalLayers,
                             presences = presences_ct,
                             distanceThreshold = 200000,
                             bathymetryLayer = "C:/Users/mmaes/OneDrive/Desktop/OCS7001_SciComp/Sci_Comp26/Sci_Comp26/Data/Raster_data/Bathymetry.tif",
                             depthPref = c(0, -60))
plot(myStudyRegion2, main = "Study Region", col="#979797", axes = TRUE)
```
```{r}
environmentalLayers <- crop(environmentalLayers, myStudyRegion2)
environmentalLayers <- mask(environmentalLayers, myStudyRegion2)
plot(environmentalLayers, axes = TRUE)
```
```{r}
absences <- pseudoAbsences(rasterLayers = environmentalLayers, presences = presences_ct, n = 2000)
landmassCT <- crop(landmass, myStudyRegion2)

plot(landmassCT, main = "Coral Triangle Species Records", col = "#D4D4D4", border = "#D4D4D4", axes = TRUE)
plot(absences, col="#c29431", pch=16, cex=0.5, add=TRUE)
plot(presences_ct, col="#043259", pch=16, cex=0.5, add=TRUE)
```
```{r}
#combine presences and absences into a unique object for modeling
presences_ct$PA <- 1
absences$PA <- 0
records <- rbind(presences_ct, absences)

# plot records
plot(landmassCT, main = "Coral Reefs Species Records", col = "#D4D4D4", border = "#D4D4D4", axes = TRUE)
plot(records, y = "PA", col=c("#c29431", "#043259"), pch=16, cex=0.5, add=TRUE)
```
```{r}
modelData <- generateModelData(records, envConditions = environmentalLayers, method = "blocks", kFolds = 10)
modelData$plotDatasets
```
```{r}
# fit a BRT model to the dataset
model <- trainModel(modelData, algorithm= "brt")

# predict the distribution with the model over a raster stack
prediction <- predictModel(model = model, newData = environmentalLayers)

# map the predicted distribution
plot(prediction$rasterLayer, main = "Predicted Species Distribution", col = rev(topo.colors(100)))
```
